subject: Getting 500 errors on /v1/completions
body: Since this morning our requests to /v1/completions return HTTP 500 internal server error intermittently. Request id req_8f3a. About 20% of calls fail.

subject: 502 bad gateway from the API
body: We see 502 bad gateway responses when sending long prompts. Retrying sometimes works. Is there a known issue with the API gateway?

subject: Invalid request error: messages must be array
body: Our payload worked yesterday but now the API returns invalid_request_error 400, messages must be an array. We did not change the client code.

subject: Streaming responses cut off mid-way
body: With stream=true the SSE connection drops after a few seconds with an unexpected EOF and we receive a truncated completion.

subject: Timeout errors calling the chat endpoint
body: Our server gets a read timeout after 60 seconds on the chat endpoint for requests with large context. We also see 504 gateway timeout in the logs.

subject: 429 Too Many Requests on production
body: We keep hitting 429 rate limit exceeded errors although we are far below the documented requests per minute limit.

subject: Need higher tokens per minute limit
body: We launch next week and need our TPM limit raised to 2M tokens per minute. How do we request a quota increase?

subject: Monthly quota exhausted early
body: Our monthly token quota was used up on the 12th. Can you show a usage breakdown or increase the quota?

subject: Rate limit headers missing on batch requests
body: The x-ratelimit-remaining header is not returned for batch requests so we cannot back off properly. Is that expected with rate limits?

subject: Concurrency limit reached
body: We get a concurrent request limit reached message when running 20 parallel workers. What is the max concurrency for the Pro plan?

subject: Responses became very slow since Monday
body: Average latency jumped from 1.5s to 9s for the same prompts. Time to first token is also much slower. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: High p99 latency in EU region
body: p99 latency for our EU users is above 12 seconds. The US region looks normal. Can you check performance routing?

subject: Embedding endpoint is slow
body: Embedding requests for batches of 100 texts take 20+ seconds now, they used to finish in 3 seconds. Throughput is much lower.

subject: Slow time to first token with streaming
body: Streaming starts only after 6-8 seconds which makes our chat UI feel laggy. Is the model overloaded?

subject: Latency doubled for long prompts
body: Prompts above 20k tokens take twice as long as last month. Is this slower inference expected?

subject: Model hallucinating product features
body: The assistant invents features that do not exist in our knowledge base even though the retrieved context is correct. Hallucinating like this is a big problem for our customers.

subject: Output quality regression after update
body: Since the model update last week answers are shorter and less accurate. Our evaluation score dropped from 92% to 81%, a clear quality regression.

subject: Inconsistent JSON output
body: Even at temperature 0 we get different answers, and sometimes the response is invalid JSON although we ask for a strict schema.

subject: Model refuses harmless requests
body: The model is refusing to summarize normal customer emails and says it cannot help. This is a false positive refusal.

subject: Wrong language in responses
body: We prompt in Spanish but the model answers in English about half the time. The system prompt clearly asks for Spanish.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: I see two charges of $499 on my credit card for the same subscription. Please refund the duplicate payment.

subject: Need invoice with VAT number
body: Can you re-issue invoice INV-2231 with our company VAT number and billing address? Our finance team needs it.

subject: Payment failed but card is valid
body: My payment failed three times although the card works elsewhere. Please help with this billing problem before the account is suspended.

subject: Annual plan pricing question
body: What is the price of the annual plan and can we switch mid-cycle without paying the monthly fee again?

subject: Cancel subscription and refund
body: Please cancel my subscription effective today. I was charged yesterday by mistake and want a refund.

subject: Cannot log in, password reset email not arriving
body: I requested a password reset several times but never get the email. I checked spam. I am locked out of my account.

subject: SSO login fails with SAML error
body: After configuring Okta SAML single sign-on our users see invalid assertion when logging in. We followed the setup guide.

subject: 2FA code not working
body: My authenticator app codes are rejected and I lost my backup codes. How do I regain access to my account?

subject: Invite to workspace link expired
body: I invited a teammate to our workspace but the invitation link says expired. How can I add users?

subject: Account locked after failed login attempts
body: My account was locked after several failed login attempts. Please unlock it, I need to access the console.

subject: 401 Unauthorized with valid API key
body: Our API key worked until today, now every request returns 401 unauthorized invalid api key. We did not rotate the key.

subject: How do I rotate API keys safely?
body: We need to rotate our secret API key without downtime. Can two api keys be active at once?

subject: 403 forbidden for project scoped key
body: Project scoped keys get 403 permission denied on the fine-tuning endpoints, but the org key works.

subject: API key shows as revoked
body: The dashboard says our api key was revoked but nobody on our team did that. Why was the key disabled? Please issue a new one.

subject: Bearer token header format error
body: Sending the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix still returns an unauthorized error. Is there a different header for the Azure endpoint?

subject: Python SDK throws TypeError on streaming
body: After upgrading the python sdk to the latest version we get TypeError: NoneType is not iterable when iterating the stream. Traceback attached.

subject: Webhook signatures failing verification
body: Our webhook endpoint rejects every event because signature verification fails. We use the documented HMAC method.

subject: LangChain integration breaks after upgrade
body: The LangChain integration raises an import error after we upgraded the package with pip. Which versions are compatible?

subject: Node SDK types missing for new parameter
body: The node sdk TypeScript types do not include the new response_format parameter, so our build fails.

subject: Zapier connector stopped triggering
body: Our Zapier integration stopped triggering zaps two days ago. Reconnecting the account did not help.

subject: Fine-tuning job failed with validation error
body: Our fine-tuning job failed immediately: invalid training file format at line 214. The JSONL looks fine to us.

subject: Fine-tune stuck in queue for 2 days
body: The training job has been pending for two days. Is there a capacity problem with fine-tuning?

subject: Dataset size limit for fine-tuning
body: What is the maximum dataset size and number of epochs for a fine-tuning job on the Pro plan?

subject: Fine-tuned model returns worse results
body: After fine-tuning on 5,000 examples the custom model performs worse than the base model. What could be wrong with our training data?

subject: Cannot deploy fine-tuned checkpoint
body: The training finished but the checkpoint cannot be deployed. The custom model endpoint returns model not found.

subject: GDPR data deletion request
body: Under GDPR we need all data for our workspace deleted, including logs. Please confirm the data retention period and deletion process.

subject: Do you train on our data?
body: Our legal team needs written confirmation that customer prompts are not used for training. How do we opt out and where is the DPA?

subject: SOC 2 report and security questionnaire
body: Procurement asks for your SOC 2 report and to complete our security questionnaire before we can sign.

subject: We accidentally leaked an API key
body: We pushed a secret key to a public GitHub repo by mistake. We revoked it but want to know if there was any unauthorized usage. Possible breach.

subject: Prompt injection vulnerability report
body: We found a prompt injection vulnerability that lets users exfiltrate the system prompt. Where can we report it responsibly?

subject: API is down - everything returns 503
body: Is the API down? All of our requests return 503 service unavailable right now. Production is down.

subject: Service unavailable across all regions
body: We cannot reach the service from any region, complete outage on our side. Nothing works.

subject: Status page says operational but we have an outage
body: Your status page shows green but the chat endpoint is not responding at all for us and our whole team.

subject: Total downtime of chat endpoint since 14:05 UTC
body: The chat endpoint has been unavailable since 14:05 UTC. Is this an outage? Customers are complaining.

subject: Is there an outage right now?
body: Everything is down for us and for other companies we know. Service unavailable 503 errors everywhere.

subject: 503 service unavailable on all endpoints
body: Every endpoint returns 503 service unavailable. Seems to be a major outage, please confirm on the status page.

subject: How do I get started with the API?
body: I'm new here. How do I make my first request? Is there a getting started tutorial in the documentation?

subject: Which model should I use for summarization?
body: Which model is best for summarizing long documents, balancing cost and quality? Any best practice?

subject: How to write a good system prompt
body: Do you have a guide on prompt engineering for classification tasks? I would like examples of good system prompts.

subject: How do I use function calling?
body: Can you point me to documentation with an example of tool use and function calling in Python?

subject: How to set a max token budget per user
body: How do I limit the maximum tokens each end user can consume? Is there a documented way?

subject: Feature request: team usage dashboard
body: It would be great to have a per-member usage dashboard. This is a feature request for the roadmap.

subject: Please add support for batch discounts
body: Please add support for discounted batch processing for non-urgent workloads. Is it planned?

subject: Dark mode for the console
body: Suggestion: add a dark mode to the web console, my eyes would thank you.

subject: Roadmap: image input support
body: Is support for image input on the roadmap? We wish to process screenshots.

subject: Feature request: export logs as CSV
body: Would be great if request logs could be exported as CSV. Feature request from our data team.

subject: Partnership opportunity
body: Hi, we are an agency interested in becoming a reseller partner. Who should we speak to?

subject: Thanks!
body: Just wanted to say your team was really helpful last week. Great job.

subject: Job application
body: I would like to apply for a position on your engineering team, where can I send my CV?
